thread:
Priya: Quick postmortem follow-up 1  we need to lock customer comms, owners for action items, and confirm RCA-sharing flow. Short thread pls.
Alex: I'll own enterprise outreach coordination. Need final statuspage wording and the 72h redacted draft.
Marcus: I'll draft the statuspage snippet. Keep it <2 lines and non-technical.
Lily: I can write the 72-hour redacted summary + the small FAQ entry. Tagging Legal for redaction rules.
Jordan: Ops should run a 90-day recurrence sweep for slow-tail latency patterns. Assign PRD-6001 to Ops.
Legal: Recommend public redacted summary + full RCA available upon verified request under confidentiality terms. We'll provide a short redaction checklist.
Priya: Agree. Please include consent blurb: "Full RCA available to verified affected customers under existing confidentiality terms; contact Support to request."
Lily: Draft FAQ line: "Redacted = internal identifiers and sensitive logs removed; timeline and root cause preserved." Legal ok?
Legal: Approved. Also suggest removing exact hostnames, vendor IDs, and internal ticket links.
Marcus: Statuspage draft:
```
Status: Partial outage impacting inference API (us-west-2)
Impact: Elevated latency and errors for a subset of requests between 02:12-02:50 UTC.
Current status: Service performance restored for most customers. A redacted technical summary will be posted within 72 hours.
```
Alex: Slight tweak: change "most" -> "majority" and add CTA link to support for RCA requests.
Marcus: Updated and will post when Lily confirms 72h language.
Jordan: PRD-6001 created for recurrence sweep, attaching PromQL queries and dashboards. OpsBot scheduled a run.
OpsBot: @Jordan Recurrence sweep job PRD-6001 queued; ETA 6h for initial results.
Lily: 72h draft posted to the postmortem doc: includes timeline, human impact line, mitigations, and "what we're doing" bullets with owners + ETA quarters.
Legal: Reviewing draft now; two small redactions requested in the technical appendix.
Lily: Removed flagged lines and replaced with higher-level descriptions. Republishing.
CS: Preparing enterprise email template with CTA + eligibility checklist. Will wait for Legal sign-off.
Alex: Once Legal approves, post redacted summary and CS will send outreach. Add T+7 reminder to #incident-owners for follow-ups.
Priya: Also adding a follow-up item: add weekly recurrence review to Optimize team's checklist. Owner: Jordan.
Jordan: Will add the recurrence detection rule and weekly review cadence.
Marcus: Statuspage snippet ready and queued. OpsBot shows publish window 20m.
OpsBot: @Marcus Statuspage update queued. Publish window: 20 minutes.
Legal: Final sign-off complete. Two redactions applied.
CS: Outreach queued; sending after statuspage publish.
Priya: Closing thread  all follow-ups in postmortem PRD-6000 and tracker. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
